name: resilience-iq-executive-report
purpose: Convert Executive Scan results into an evidence-aware CIO/CTO advisory report without overstating certainty.

recommendation_sensitivity.purpose: Explain conditions that could change the preferred recovery strategy.

decision_points: Validate target RTO/RPO and impact tolerance
Approve preferred recovery strategy for detailed design
Approve cyber recovery and identity recovery controls
Approve dependency and third-party resilience remediation

evidence_lifecycle.validation_rule: Only evidence explicitly validated against validation_criteria may increase evidence maturity or recommendation confidence.
evidence_lifecycle.recommendation_rule: Evidence marked provided, validated or rejected must be reflected in the assessment decision log; validated material evidence may trigger recommendation sensitivity and reassessment.
evidence_lifecycle.material_evidence_rule: Evidence affects recommendation confidence only when its status is validated and affects_recommendation is true; provided evidence remains unvalidated.
